title: DeHack
tagline: A blazing fast cross-chain bridge utilizing account abstraction across all EVM chains
description: A blazing fast cross-chain bridge utilizing account abstraction across all EVM chains offers a seamless and efficient way to transfer assets. By enabling instant transactions and automating processes through smart contract wallets, users can enjoy a streamlined experience without the complexities of traditional cross-chain methods. This bridge optimizes gas fees and enhances security with additional measures like multi-signatures. Ultimately, it promotes improved liquidity and universal compatibility, making it a vital tool for the evolving DeFi ecosystem.
